Example: .. code-block:: lua fastplace = { warehouse = "atlanteans_warehouse", port = "atlanteans_port", } .. _lua_tribes_tribes_helptexts: Helptexts --------- Helptexts are used in the Tribal Encyclopedia to give the users some basic information and lore about units. They are optional and defined in a ``helptexts`` subtable in the unit's listing. Example for a building: .. code-block:: lua buildings = { { name = "barbarians_ax_workshop", helptexts = { Lore helptext for a Barbarian production site: Ax Workshop lore = pgettext("barbarians_building", "‘A new warrior’s ax brings forth the best in its wielder – or the worst in its maker.’"), Lore author helptext for a Barbarian production site: Ax Workshop lore_author = pgettext("barbarians_building", "An old Barbarian proverb
meaning that you need to take some risks sometimes."), Purpose helptext for a Barbarian production site: Ax Workshop purpose = pgettext("barbarians_building", "Produces axes, sharp axes and broad axes."), Note helptext for a Barbarian production site: Ax Workshop note = pgettext("barbarians_building", "The Barbarian ax workshop is the intermediate production site in a series of three buildings. It is enhanced from the metal workshop but doesn’t require additional qualification for the worker."), performance = { Performance helptext for a Barbarian production site: Ax Workshop, part 1 pgettext("barbarians_building", "If all needed wares are delivered in time, this building can produce each type of ax in about %s on average."):bformat(format_seconds(57)), Performance helptext for a Barbarian production site: Ax Workshop, part 2 pgettext("barbarians_building", "All three weapons take the same time for making, but the required raw materials vary.") } }, ... }, immovables { ... }, wares { ... }, workers { ... } } * All units should have a ``purpose`` helptext, but this is not enforced by the engine. * Empty helptexts are allowed, although they will log a warning to the console to help you find missing helptexts. * ``lore``, ``lore_author`` and ``note`` are only used by buildings, ``performance`` is only used by training site and production site buildings. * The tribe’s scouting building should additionally define a ``no_scouting_building_connected`` text which will be shown in the UI when the Send Scout To Flag button is disabled for lack of a connected scout’s house/hut. * We recommend that you use ``pgettext`` to disambiguate the strings for the different tribes. * To make life easier for our translators, you can split long helptexts into multiple entries as with the ``performance`` example above. The helptexts are then joined by the engine. In our example, we will get *"If all needed wares are delivered in time, this building can produce each type of ax in about 57 seconds on average. All three weapons take the same time for making, but the required raw materials vary."* For formatting time strings Image file paths for this tribe's road and waterway textures Wares positions in wares windows. This also gives us the information which wares the tribe uses. Each subtable is a column in the wares windows. source.other: The Barbarians produce granite blocks in quarries and granite mines.

target.other: Barbarerna producerar granitblock i stenbrott och i granitgruvor.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Granite, part 2

source.other: Barbarian lumberjacks fell the trees; rangers take care of the supply of trees. Logs are also used in the metal workshop to build basic tools, and in the charcoal kiln for the production of coal. The wood hardener refines logs into blackwood by hardening them with fire.

target.other: Barbariska skogshuggare fäller träden, skogvaktare ser till att nya träd växer upp. Stockar används också i metallverkstaden för att göra verktyg och i kolmilan vid produktionen av kol. Trähärdaren förädlar stockarna till härdat trä genom att härda dem med eld.

key: Barbarian lumberjacks fell the trees; rangers take care of the supply of trees. Logs are also used in the metal workshop to build basic tools, and in the charcoal kiln for the production of coal. The wood hardener refines logs into blackwood by hardening them with fire.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Log, part 2

source.other: This fire-hardened wood is as hard as iron and it is used for several buildings. It is produced out of logs in the wood hardener.

target.other: Detta eldhärdade trä är hårt som järn och används i flera byggnadstyper. Det produceras av stockar i trähärderiet.

key: This fire-hardened wood is as hard as iron and it is used for several buildings. It is produced out of logs in the wood hardener.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Blackwood

target.other: Granit kan omvandlas till murbruk, vilket är ett hårt och inte brännbart material. Murbruk produceras i ett kalkbränneri.

key: Granite can be processed into grout which provides a solid, non burning building material. Grout is produced in a lime kiln.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Grout

key: Meat is used in the taverns, inns and big inns to prepare rations, snacks and meals for the miners. It is also consumed at the training sites (training camp and battle arena).

source.other: The Barbarian bakers are best in making this flat and tasty pitta bread. It is made out of wheat and water following a secret recipe. Pitta bread is used in the taverns, inns and big inns to prepare rations, snacks and meals. It is also consumed at training sites (training camp and battle arena).

target.other: Barbarbagarna är bäst på att baka detta platta och välsmakande pitabröd. Det framställs av vete och vatten efter ett hemligt recept. Pitabröd används i krogar, värdshus och stora värdshus för att tillreda matbitar, matportioner och måltider. Det äts också i träningsanläggningar (träningsläger och stridsarena).

target.other: Bara denna öl är bra nog för soldaterna i stridsarenan. Vissa säger att hela kraften hos barbarerna ligger i deras öl. Den hjälper till att träna upp soldaternas förmåga att parera från nivå 0 till 1 och sedan upp till 2. Starköl används också till måltider tillagade i stora värdshus.

target.other: En större munsbit än matbiten att ge gruvarbetarna i de djupa gruvorna. Den tillreds i ett värdshus eller ett stort värdshus av fisk eller kött, pitabröd och öl.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Snack

source.other: A meal is made out of pitta bread, strong beer and fish/meat in a big inn. This substantial food is exactly what workers in a deeper mine need.

target.other: En måltid tillreds av pitabröd, starköl och fisk eller kött i ett stort värdshus. Den här bastanta maten är just vad gruvarbetarna i de djupare gruvorna behöver.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Meal

source.other: The fires of the Barbarians are usually fed with coal. Consumers are several buildings: lime kiln, smelting works, ax workshop, war mill, and helm smithy.

target.other: Barbarernas eldar föds vanligtvis av kol. Konsumenter är flera byggnader: kalkbränneri, smältverk, yxverkstad, vapenverkstad och hjälmsedja.

key: The fires of the Barbarians are usually fed with coal. Consumers are several buildings: lime kiln, smelting works, ax workshop, war mill, and helm smithy.

source.other: It is smelted in a smelting works to retrieve the iron.

source.other: It is produced by the smelting works and used to produce weapons and tools in the metal workshop, ax workshop, war mill and helm smithy.

target.other: Det produceras av smältverket och används för att tillverka vapen och verktyg i metallverkstaden, yxverkstaden, krigsfabriken och hjälmsmedjan.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Iron, part 2

target.other: Smält i ett smältverk förvandlas det till guld som används som ett värdefullt byggmaterial och för att tillverka vapen och rustningar.

source.other: Only very important things are embellished with gold. It is produced by the smelting works and used as a precious building material and to produce different axes (in the war mill) and different parts of armor (in the helm smithy).

target.other: Endast mycket viktiga saker förgylls med guld. Det produceras av smältverket och används som ett värdefullt byggmaterial och för att tillverka olika yxor (i krigsmjölken) och olika delar av rustningar (i hjälmsmedjan).

key: Only very important things are embellished with gold. It is produced by the smelting works and used as a precious building material and to produce different axes (in the war mill) and different parts of armor (in the helm smithy).

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Ax

source.other: Young soldiers are proud to learn to fight with this powerful weapon. It is heavier and sharper than the ordinary ax. It is produced in ax workshops and war mills. In training camps, it is used – together with food – to train soldiers from attack level 0 to level 1.

target.other: Unga soldater är stolta över att få lära sig slåss med detta kraftfulla vapen. Den är tyngre och vassare än den ordinarie yxan. Den tillverkas i yxverkstäder och vapenverkstäder. I träningsläger används den – tillsammans med mat – för att träna soldater från attacknivå 0 till nivå 1.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Sharp Ax

source.other: The broad ax is produced by the ax workshop and the war mill. It is used in the training camp – together with food – to train soldiers with a fundamental fighting knowledge from attack level 1 to attack level 2.

target.other: Bredyxan produceras i yxverkstaden och vapenverkstaden. Den används i träningslägret – tillsammans med mat – för att träna soldater med grundläggande stridskunskap från attacknivå 1 till nivå 2.

key: The broad ax is produced by the ax workshop and the war mill. It is used in the training camp – together with food – to train soldiers with a fundamental fighting knowledge from attack level 1 to attack level 2.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Broad Ax

source.other: The bronze ax is considered a weapon that is hard to handle. Only skilled soldiers can use it. It is produced at the war mill and used in the training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from attack level 2 to level 3.

target.other: Bronsyxan ses som ett svårbemästrat vapen. Bara skickliga soldater kan använda den. Den tillverkas i vapenverkstaden och används i träningslägret – tillsammans med mat – för att träna soldater från attacknivå 2 till nivå 3.

source.other: This is a dangerous weapon the Barbarians are able to produce. It is produced in the war mill. Only trained soldiers are able to wield such a weapon. It is used – together with food – in the training camp to train soldiers from attack level 3 to 4.

target.other: Detta är ett farligt vapen som barbarerna kan tillverka. Det tillverkas i vapenverkstaden. Bara tränade soldater kan svinga ett sådant vapen. Det används – tillsammans med mat – i träningslägret för att träna soldater från attacknivå 3 till nivå 4.

source.other: The warrior’s ax is the most dangerous of all Barbarian weapons. Only a few soldiers ever were able to handle this huge and powerful ax. It is produced in a war mill and used – together with food – in a training camp to train soldiers from attack level 4 to level 5.

‘What’s the work of a charcoal burner?

Logs on logs he piles up high,
Until the kiln will reach the sky.
He sets the fire, sees it smolder
The logs he carried on his shoulder.
Burnt down to just one single coal
This troubles much a burner’s soul.’

Trästockarna han bar på sina axlar.
Brända ner till en enda kolbit
Detta bekymrar mycket en brännares själ.

source.other: The Empire produces granite blocks in quarries and marble mines.

target.other: Imperiet producerar granitblock i stenbrott och i marmorgruvor.

key: The Empire produces granite blocks in quarries and marble mines.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Granite, part 2

source.other: Imperial lumberjacks fell the trees; foresters take care of the supply of trees. Logs are also used by the charcoal kiln, the toolsmithy and the sawmill.

target.other: Imperiets skogshuggare fäller träden, skogvaktare planterar nya. Stockar används också i kolmilan, av verktygssmedjan och i sågverket.

key: Imperial lumberjacks fell the trees; foresters take care of the supply of trees. Logs are also used by the charcoal kiln, the toolsmithy and the sawmill.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Log, part 2

source.other: They are produced out of logs by the sawmill.

target.other: De tillverkas av timmerstockar i sågverket.

key: They are produced out of logs by the sawmill.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Planks, part 2

source.other: They are also used by the weapon smithy.

key: They are also used by the weapon smithy.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Planks, part 3

source.other: Wool is the hair of sheep. Weaving mills use it to make cloth.

target.other: Ull är fårens hår. Väverier använder det för att göra tyg.

key: Wool is the hair of sheep. Weaving mills use it to make cloth.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Wool

source.other: Cloth is needed to build several buildings. It is also consumed in the armor smithy.

target.other: Tyg behövs för att bygga flera byggnader. Det används också av rustningssmedjan.

key: Cloth is needed to build several buildings. It is also consumed in the armor smithy.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Cloth

source.other: Besides bread and meat, fish is also a foodstuff for the Empire. Fish are used in taverns, inns and training sites (arena, colosseum, training camp).

target.other: Förutom bröd och kött ingår även fisk i Imperiets föda. Fisk används i krogar, värdshus och i träningsanläggningar (arena, colosseum och träningsläger).

key: Besides bread and meat, fish is also a foodstuff for the Empire. Fish are used in taverns, inns and training sites (arena, colosseum, training camp).
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Fish

source.other: Meat can also be obtained as pork from piggeries. It is used in the inns and taverns to prepare lunch for the miners and is consumed at the training sites (arena, colosseum, training camp).

target.other: Kött kan också fås som skinka från grisuppfödningar. Det används av krogar och värdshus för att tillreda mat åt gruvarbetarna och det äts också i träningsanläggningarna (arena, colosseum och träningsläger).

key: Meat can also be obtained as pork from piggeries. It is used in the inns and taverns to prepare lunch for the miners and is consumed at the training sites (arena, colosseum, training camp).
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Meat, part 2

source.other: Water is used in the bakery and the brewery. The donkey farm, the sheep farm and the piggery also need to be supplied with water.

target.other: Vatten används i bageriet och bryggeriet. Åsneuppfödningen, fåruppfödningen och grisuppfödningen behöver också förses med vatten.

key: Water is used in the bakery and the brewery. The donkey farm, the sheep farm and the piggery also need to be supplied with water.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Water, part 2

source.other: Wheat is produced by farms and used by mills and breweries. Donkey farms, sheep farms and piggeries also need to be supplied with wheat.

target.other: Vete produceras av jordbruk och används av kvarnar och bryggerier. Åsne-, får- och grisgårdar behöver också förses med vete.

key: Wheat is produced by farms and used by mills and breweries. Donkey farms, sheep farms and piggeries also need to be supplied with wheat.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Wheat, part 2

source.other: Flour is produced by the mill out of wheat and is needed in the bakery to produce the tasty Empire bread.

target.other: Mjöl mals i kvarnen av vete och behövs i bageriet för att baka det goda imperiebrödet.

key: Flour is produced by the mill out of wheat and is needed in the bakery to produce the tasty Empire bread.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Flour

source.other: The bakers of the Empire make really tasty bread out of flour and water. It is used in taverns and inns to prepare rations and meals. Bread is also consumed at the training sites (arena, colosseum, training camp).

target.other: Imperiets bagare bakar riktigt gott bröd av mjöl och vatten. Det används i krogar och värdshus för att tillreda matbitar och måltider. Bröd äts också i träningsanläggningarna (arena, colosseum och träningsläger).

key: The bakers of the Empire make really tasty bread out of flour and water. It is used in taverns and inns to prepare rations and meals. Bread is also consumed at the training sites (arena, colosseum, training camp).
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Bread

source.other: This beer is produced in a brewery out of wheat and water. It is consumed by miners in coal and iron mines.

target.other: Denna öl produceras av vete och vatten i ett bryggeri. Den dricks av gruvarbetare i kol- och järngruvor.

key: This beer is produced in a brewery out of wheat and water. It is consumed by miners in coal and iron mines.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Beer

source.other: These grapes are the base for a tasty wine. They are harvested in a vineyard and processed in a winery.

target.other: Dessa vindruvor utgör grunden för ett gott vin. De skördas på vingården och förädlas i en vinjäsningsanläggning.

key: These grapes are the base for a tasty wine. They are harvested in a vineyard and processed in a winery.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Grape

source.other: This tasty wine is drunk by the miners working the marble and gold mines. It is produced in a winery.

target.other: Detta goda vin dricks av gruvarbetarna som jobbar i marmor- och guldgruvorna. Det produceras i en vinjäsningsanläggning.

key: This tasty wine is drunk by the miners working the marble and gold mines. It is produced in a winery.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Wine

source.other: Rations are produced in a tavern out of fish or meat or bread.

target.other: Matbitar tillreds i en krog av fisk eller kött och bröd.

key: Rations are produced in a tavern out of fish or meat or bread.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Ration, part 2

source.other: A real meal is made in inns out of bread and fish/meat. It satisfies the needs of miners in deep mines.

target.other: En riktig måltid tillreds i värdshus av bröd och fisk eller kött. Den tillfredsställer behoven hos gruvarbetarna i de djupa gruvorna.

key: A real meal is made in inns out of bread and fish/meat. It satisfies the needs of miners in deep mines.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Meal

source.other: Marble is the beautiful stone which is cut out of the mountains or produced in a quarry. Marble is used as a building material and gets chiseled into marble columns in the stonemason’s house.

target.other: Marmor är en vacker sten som huggs ur bergen eller i stenbrotten. Marmor används som byggnadsmaterial och huggs till marmorpelare i stenhuggeriet.

key: Marble is the beautiful stone which is cut out of the mountains or produced in a quarry. Marble is used as a building material and gets chiseled into marble columns in the stonemason’s house.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Marble

source.other: Marble columns represent the high culture of the Empire, so they are needed for nearly every larger building. They are produced out of marble at a stonemason’s house.

target.other: Marmorpelare representerar Imperiets höga kultur och behövs i nästan alla stora byggnader. De produceras av marmor i stenhuggeriet.

key: Marble columns represent the high culture of the Empire, so they are needed for nearly every larger building. They are produced out of marble at a stonemason’s house.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Marble Column

source.other: The fires of the Empire smelting works, armor smithies and weapon smithies are usually fed with coal.

target.other: I eldstäderna i Imperiets smältverk, rustningssmedjor och vapensmedjor är det kol som brinner.

key: The fires of the Empire smelting works, armor smithies and weapon smithies are usually fed with coal.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Coal, part 2

source.other: It is smelted in a smelting works to retrieve the iron.

target.other: Det smälts i ett smältverk för att utvinna järnet.

key: It is smelted in a smelting works to retrieve the iron.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Iron Ore, part 2

source.other: It is produced by the smelting works. Weapons, armor and tools are made of iron.

target.other: Det produceras av smältverket. Vapen, rustningar och verktyg tillverkas av järn.

key: It is produced by the smelting works. Weapons, armor and tools are made of iron.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Iron, part 2

source.other: Smelted in a smelting works, it turns into gold which is used as a precious building material and to produce weapons and armor.

target.other: Smält i ett smältverk förvandlas det till guld som används som ett värdefullt byggmaterial och för att tillverka vapen och rustningar.

key: Smelted in a smelting works, it turns into gold which is used as a precious building material and to produce weapons and armor.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Gold Ore, part 2

source.other: It is produced by the smelting works. Armor and weapons are embellished with gold in the armor smithy and the weapon smithy.

target.other: Det produceras av smältverket. Rustningar och vapen förgylls i rustningssmedjan och vapensmedjan.

key: It is produced by the smelting works. Armor and weapons are embellished with gold in the armor smithy and the weapon smithy.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Gold, part 2

source.other: Picks are used by stonemasons and miners. They are produced by the toolsmith.

target.other: Hackor används av stenhuggare och gruvarbetare. De produceras av verktygssmeden.

key: Picks are used by stonemasons and miners. They are produced by the toolsmith.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Pick

source.other: Felling axes are used by lumberjacks and produced by the toolsmithy.

target.other: Fällningsyxor används av skogshuggare och tillverkas av verktygssmedjan.

key: Felling axes are used by lumberjacks and produced by the toolsmithy.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Felling Ax, part 2

source.other: This saw is needed by the carpenter. It is produced by the toolsmith.

target.other: Snickaren behöver denna såg. Den tillverkas av verktygssmeden.

key: This saw is needed by the carpenter. It is produced by the toolsmith.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Saw

source.other: Therefore the forester and the vine farmer use them. They are produced by the toolsmith.

target.other: Därför använder skogvaktaren och vinodlaren dem. De tillverkas av verktygssmeden.

key: Therefore the forester and the vine farmer use them. They are produced by the toolsmith.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Shovel, part 2

source.other: Geologists, builders, weaponsmiths, armorsmiths and shipwrights all need a hammer. Make sure you’ve always got some in reserve! They are produced by the toolsmith.

target.other: Geologer, byggare, vapensmeder, rustningssmeder och skeppsbyggare behöver alla en hammare. Se till att du alltid har några i reserv! De tillverkas av verktygssmeden.

target.other: De används i smältverket och tillverkas av verktygssmeden.

key: They are used in the smelting works and produced by the toolsmith.

source.other: This wooden spear is the basic weapon in the Empire military system. It is produced in the weapon smithy. In combination with a helmet, it is the equipment to fit out young soldiers.

target.other: Träspjutet är grundvapnet för Imperiets militär. Det tillverkas i vapensmedjan. I kombination med en hjälm är det den utrustning som unga soldater förses med.

key: This wooden spear is the basic weapon in the Empire military system. It is produced in the weapon smithy. In combination with a helmet, it is the equipment to fit out young soldiers.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Wooden Spear

source.other: This spear has an iron spike. It is produced in a weapon smithy and used in a training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from attack level 0 to attack level 1.

target.other: Detta spjut har ingen järnspets. Det tillverkas av vapensmeden och används i träningslägret – tillsammans med mat – för att träna soldater från attacknivå 0 till nivå 1.

key: This spear has an iron spike. It is produced in a weapon smithy and used in a training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from attack level 0 to attack level 1.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Spear

source.other: This is an advanced spear with a steel tip. It is produced in a weapon smithy and used in a training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from attack level 1 to level 2.

target.other: Detta är ett avancerat spjut med stålspets. Det tillverkas i vapensmedjan och används i träningslägret – tillsammans med mat – för att träna soldater från attacknivå 1 till nivå 2.

key: This is an advanced spear with a steel tip. It is produced in a weapon smithy and used in a training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from attack level 1 to level 2.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Advanced Spear

source.other: This is a strong spear with a steel-tip and a little blade. It is produced in the weapon smithy and used in the training camp – together with food – train soldiers from attack level 2 to level 3.

target.other: Detta är ett starkt spjut med en stålspets och en liten vass egg. Det tillverkas i vapensmedjan och används i träningslägret – tillsammans med mat – för att träna soldater från attacknivå 2 till nivå 3.

key: This is a strong spear with a steel-tip and a little blade. It is produced in the weapon smithy and used in the training camp – together with food – train soldiers from attack level 2 to level 3.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Heavy Spear

source.other: This is the best and sharpest weapon the Empire weaponsmith creates for the soldiers. It is used in the training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from attack level 3 to level 4.

target.other: Detta är det bästa och vassaste vapen som Imperiets vapensmeder tillverkar åt soldaterna. Det används i träningslägren – tillsammans med mat – för att träna soldaterna från attacknivå 3 till nivå 4.

key: This is the best and sharpest weapon the Empire weaponsmith creates for the soldiers. It is used in the training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from attack level 3 to level 4.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: War Spear

source.other: The helmet is the basic defense of a soldier. It is produced in an armor smithy. In combination with a wooden spear, it is the equipment to fit out young soldiers. Helmets are also used in training camps – together with food – to train soldiers from health level 0 to level 1.

target.other: Hjälmen är soldatens grundläggande skydd. Den tillverkas i en vapensmedja. Tillsammans med ett träspruta är det den utrustning som unga soldater förses med. Hjälmar används också i träningsläger – tillsammans med mat – för att träna soldater från hälsonivå 0 till nivå 1.

key: The helmet is the basic defense of a soldier. It is produced in an armor smithy. In combination with a wooden spear, it is the equipment to fit out young soldiers. Helmets are also used in training camps – together with food – to train soldiers from health level 0 to level 1.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Helmet

source.other: Basic armor for Empire soldiers. It is produced in the armor smithy and used in the training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from health level 1 to level 2.

target.other: Den enklaste skyddsklädseln för imperiesoldater. Den produceras i vapensmedjan och används i träningslägret – tillsammans med mat – för att träna soldater från hälsonivå 1 till nivå 2.

target.other: Nätbrynjan är en medeltung skyddsklädsel för imperiesoldaterna. Den produceras i vapensmedjan och används i träningslägret – tillsammans med mat – för att träna soldater från hälsonivå 2 till nivå 3.

source.other: Woodcutters fell the trees; foresters take care of the supply of trees. Logs are also used in the blacksmithy to build basic tools, and in the charcoal kiln for the production of coal. Smokeries use logs as fuel for smoking meat and fish.

target.other: Skogshuggare fäller träden och skogsvaktare sköter om trädbeståndet. Trästockar används också i smedjan för att tillverka grundläggande verktyg och i kolugnen för att producera kol. Rökeri använder trestockar som bränsle för att röka kött och fisk.

key: Woodcutters fell the trees; foresters take care of the supply of trees. Logs are also used in the blacksmithy to build basic tools, and in the charcoal kiln for the production of coal. Smokeries use logs as fuel for smoking meat and fish.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Log, part 2

source.other: The Frisians produce granite blocks in quarries and rock mines. They can be refined in a brick kiln.

target.other: Friserna producerar granitblock i stenbrott och gruvor. De kan förädlas i en tegelugn.

key: The Frisians produce granite blocks in quarries and rock mines. They can be refined in a brick kiln.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Granite, part 2

source.other: Clay is made out of water and mud to be turned into bricks, used in ship construction and to improve the charcoal kiln.

target.other: Lera tillverkas av vatten och gyttja för att sedan formas till tegelstenar, som används vid skeppsbyggnad och för att förbättra kolugnen.

key: Clay is made out of water and mud to be turned into bricks, used in ship construction and to improve the charcoal kiln.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Clay

source.other: Bricks are the best and most important building material. They are made out of a mix of clay and granite dried in a coal fire.

target.other: Tegelstenar är det bästa och viktigaste byggmaterialet. De tillverkas av en blandning av lera och granit som torkas i en koleld.

key: Bricks are the best and most important building material. They are made out of a mix of clay and granite dried in a coal fire.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Brick

source.other: Reed is grown in a reed farm. Nothing is better suited to make roofs waterproof. It is also used to make baskets and fishing nets as well as cloth.

target.other: Vass odlas på en vassodling. Inget är bättre lämpat för att göra tak vattentäta. Det används också för att tillverka korgar och fisknät samt tyg.

key: Reed is grown in a reed farm. Nothing is better suited to make roofs waterproof. It is also used to make baskets and fishing nets as well as cloth.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Reed

source.other: Fur is won from reindeer in a reindeer farm. It is woven into cloth or turned into fur garments for soldiers.

target.other: Päls vinns från renar på en renfarm. Den vävs till tyg eller förvandlas till pälskläder för soldater.

key: Fur is won from reindeer in a reindeer farm. It is woven into cloth or turned into fur garments for soldiers.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Fur

source.other: Cloth is needed for ships. It is produced out of reindeer fur and reed.

target.other: Tyg behövs för fartyg. Det tillverkas av renhår och vass.

key: Cloth is needed for ships. It is produced out of reindeer fur and reed.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Cloth

source.other: Fruit are berries gathered from berry bushes by a fruit collector. They are used for rations and for feeding the fish at the aqua farms.

target.other: Frukt är bär som plockas från bärbuskar av en fruktplockare. De används som proviant och som foder till fiskarna på vattenbruk.

key: Fruit are berries gathered from berry bushes by a fruit collector. They are used for rations and for feeding the fish at the aqua farms.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Fruit

source.other: Water is used to bake bread and brew beer. Reindeer farms and aqua farms also consume it.

target.other: Vatten används för att baka bröd och brygga öl. Renfarmer och vattenbruk förbrukar också vatten.

key: Water is used to bake bread and brew beer. Reindeer farms and aqua farms also consume it.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Water, part 2

source.other: Barley is a slow-growing grain that is used for baking bread and brewing beer. It is also eaten by reindeer.

target.other: Korn är ett långsamt växande spannmål som används för att baka bröd och brygga öl. Det äts också av renar.

key: Barley is a slow-growing grain that is used for baking bread and brewing beer. It is also eaten by reindeer.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Barley

source.other: Honey is produced by bees belonging to a beekeeper. It is used to bake honey bread and brew mead.

target.other: Honung produceras av bin som tillhör en biodlare. Den används för att baka honungsbröd och brygga mjöd.

key: Honey is produced by bees belonging to a beekeeper. It is used to bake honey bread and brew mead.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Honey

source.other: Bread is made out of barley and water and is used in the taverns to prepare rations. It is also consumed by training soldiers.

target.other: Bröd tillverkas av korn och vatten och används i krogarna för att tillaga ransoner. Det konsumeras också av soldater under träning.

key: Bread is made out of barley and water and is used in the taverns to prepare rations. It is also consumed by training soldiers.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Bread

source.other: This bread is sweetened with honey. It is consumed by the most experienced miners and in advanced soldier training.

target.other: Detta bröd är sötat med honung. Det konsumeras av de mest erfarna gruvarbetarna och i avancerad soldatutbildning.

key: This bread is sweetened with honey. It is consumed by the most experienced miners and in advanced soldier training.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Honey Bread

source.other: Beer is produced in breweries and used in drinking halls to produce meals. Soldiers drink beer while receiving basic training.

target.other: Öl produceras i bryggerier och används i matsalar för att tillaga måltider. Soldater dricker öl under grundutbildningen.

key: Beer is produced in breweries and used in drinking halls to produce meals. Soldiers drink beer while receiving basic training.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Beer

source.other: Mead is produced by mead breweries. Soldiers drink mead during advanced training.

target.other: Mjöd produceras av mjödbryggerier. Soldater dricker mjöd under avancerad träning.

key: Mead is produced by mead breweries. Soldiers drink mead during advanced training.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Mead

source.other: Fish is a very important food resource for the Frisians. It is fished from the shore or reared in aqua farms.

target.other: Fisk är en mycket viktig livsmedelsresurs för friserna. Den fiskas från stranden eller odlas i vattenbruk.

key: Fish is a very important food resource for the Frisians. It is fished from the shore or reared in aqua farms.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Fish

source.other: Meat has to be smoked in a smokery before being delivered to taverns, drinking halls and training sites.

target.other: Köttet måste rökas i en rökugn innan det levereras till krogar, dryckeslokaler och träningsanläggningar.

key: Meat has to be smoked in a smokery before being delivered to taverns, drinking halls and training sites.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Meat, part 2

source.other: Fish is smoked in a smokery. Smoked fish is then consumed by soldiers in training or turned into rations and meals for miners and scouts.

target.other: Fisk röks i ett rökeri. Rökt fisk konsumeras sedan av tränande soldater eller görs om till matbitar och måltider åt gruvarbetare och spejare.

key: Fish is smoked in a smokery. Smoked fish is then consumed by soldiers in training or turned into rations and meals for miners and scouts.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Smoked Fish

source.other: Meat is smoked in a smokery. Smoked meat is then consumed by soldiers in training or turned into rations and meals for miners and scouts.

target.other: Kött röks i ett rökeri. Rökt kött konsumeras sedan av tränande soldater eller görs om till matbitar och måltider åt gruvarbetare och spejare.

key: Meat is smoked in a smokery. Smoked meat is then consumed by soldiers in training or turned into rations and meals for miners and scouts.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Smoked Meat

source.other: Rations are produced in taverns and drinking halls out of something to eat: Fruit, bread or smoked meat or fish.

target.other: Ransonerna tillverkas i tavernor och dryckeslokaler av något att äta: frukt, bröd eller rökt kött eller fisk.

key: Rations are produced in taverns and drinking halls out of something to eat: Fruit, bread or smoked meat or fish.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Ration, part 2

source.other: A meal is made out of honey bread and beer and either smoked fish or meat. It is consumed by miners in deep mines.

target.other: En måltid består av honungsbröd och öl samt antingen rökt fisk eller kött. Den äts av gruvarbetare i djupa gruvor.

key: A meal is made out of honey bread and beer and either smoked fish or meat. It is consumed by miners in deep mines.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Meal

source.other: Coal is mined in coal mines or produced out of logs by a charcoal burner in a charcoal kiln or charcoal burner’s house.

target.other: Kol bryts i kolgruvor eller framställs av stockar av en kolbrännare i en kolugn eller ett kolbrännarhus.

key: Coal is mined in coal mines or produced out of logs by a charcoal burner in a charcoal kiln or charcoal burner’s house.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Coal, part 1

source.other: The fires of the brick kilns, furnaces, armor smithies and recycling centers are fed with coal.

target.other: Eldarna i tegelfabrikerna, ugnarna, rustningssmedjorna och återvinningscentralerna eldas med kol.

key: The fires of the brick kilns, furnaces, armor smithies and recycling centers are fed with coal.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Coal, part 2

source.other: It is smelted in a furnace to retrieve the iron.

target.other: Det smälts i en ugn för att utvinna järnet.

key: It is smelted in a furnace to retrieve the iron.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Iron Ore, part 2

source.other: It is produced by the furnace. Tools and weapons are made of iron. It is also used as jewellery for fur garment armor to give it a silver shine.

target.other: Det produceras i en ugn. Verktyg och vapen tillverkas av järn. Det används också som smycken för pälsplagg och rustningar för att ge dem en silverkänsla.

key: It is produced by the furnace. Tools and weapons are made of iron. It is also used as jewellery for fur garment armor to give it a silver shine.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Iron, part 2

source.other: Smelted in a furnace, it turns into gold which is used as a precious building material and to produce weapons and armor.

target.other: Smält i en ugn förvandlas det till guld som används som ett värdefullt byggmaterial och för att tillverka vapen och rustningar.

key: Smelted in a furnace, it turns into gold which is used as a precious building material and to produce weapons and armor.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Gold Ore, part 2

source.other: Only very important things are embellished with gold. It is produced by the furnace and is used to produce better swords and the best helmets. The best armor is also decorated with gold.

target.other: Endast mycket viktiga saker är utsmyckade med guld. Det produceras i en ugn och används för att tillverka bättre svärd och de bästa hjälmarna. Den bästa rustningen är också dekorerad med guld.

key: Only very important things are embellished with gold. It is produced by the furnace and is used to produce better swords and the best helmets. The best armor is also decorated with gold.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Gold, part 2

source.other: Discarded weapons and armor can be recycled in a recycling center to produce new tools, weapon and armor.

target.other: Kasserade vapen och rustningar kan återvinnas i ett återvinningscenter för att tillverka nya verktyg, vapen och rustningar.

key: Discarded weapons and armor can be recycled in a recycling center to produce new tools, weapon and armor.
developer_comment:
TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Scrap Iron
TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Scrap metal (mixed)

source.other: Old garments can be turned into fur in a recycling center.

target.other: Gamla kläder kan omvandlas till päls i ett återvinningscenter.

key: Old garments can be turned into fur in a recycling center.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Old Fur Garment

source.other: Picks are used by stonemasons and miners.

target.other: Hackor används av stenhuggare och gruvarbetare.

key: Picks are used by stonemasons and miners.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Pick

source.other: Felling axes are used by woodcutters and produced by the blacksmithy.

target.other: Fällningsyxor används av skogshuggare och tillverkas av smederiet.

key: Felling axes are used by woodcutters and produced by the blacksmithy.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Felling Ax, part 2

source.other: They are used by berry and reed farmers as well as foresters. Clay diggers also need them to dig mud out of hard soil.

target.other: De används av bär- och vassodlare samt skogsbrukare. Lergrävare behöver dem också för att gräva lera ur hård jord.

key: They are used by berry and reed farmers as well as foresters. Clay diggers also need them to dig mud out of hard soil.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Shovel, part 2

source.other: Geologists, builders, blacksmiths and shipwrights all need a hammer. Make sure you’ve always got some in reserve! They are produced by the blacksmithy.

target.other: Geologer, byggare, smeder och skeppsbyggare behöver alla en hammare. Se till att du alltid har några i reserv! De tillverkas av smedjan.

key: Geologists, builders, blacksmiths and shipwrights all need a hammer. Make sure you’ve always got some in reserve! They are produced by the blacksmithy.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Hammer, part 2

source.other: Fishing nets are the tool used by fishers.

target.other: Fisknät är det redskap som fiskare använder.

key: Fishing nets are the tool used by fishers.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Fishing Net

source.other: Hunting spears are produced by the blacksmithy

key: Hunting spears are produced by the blacksmithy
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Hunting Spear, part 2

source.other: Scythes are produced by the blacksmithy.

key: Scythes are produced by the blacksmithy.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Scythe, part 2

source.other: Bread paddles are produced by the blacksmithy.

key: Bread paddles are produced by the blacksmithy.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Bread Paddle, part 2

source.other: Kitchen tools are needed for preparing rations and meals. The smoker also needs them.

target.other: Köksredskap behövs för att tillaga mat och måltider. Rökaren behöver dem också.

key: Kitchen tools are needed for preparing rations and meals. The smoker also needs them.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Kitchen Tools

source.other: They are used in the furnace and the brick kiln and produced by the blacksmithy.

target.other: De används i ugnen och tegelugnen och tillverkas av smedjan.

key: They are used in the furnace and the brick kiln and produced by the blacksmithy.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Fire Tongs, part 2

source.other: Baskets are needed by the fruit collector to gather berries. They are woven from reed and wood by the blacksmith.

target.other: Korgar behövs av fruktplockaren för att samla bär. De vävs av vass och trä av smeden.

key: Baskets are needed by the fruit collector to gather berries. They are woven from reed and wood by the blacksmith.
developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Basket

source.other: Needles are used by seamstresses to sew cloth and fur garments.

target.other: Nålar används av sömmerskor för att sy kläder av tyg och päls.

key: Needles are used by seamstresses to sew cloth and fur garments.
